title: CTIA-ODE: Continuous-Time Inter-Variable Attention for Long-Term Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.19831v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Although multivariate time series forecasting has broad application prospects, effectively incorporating exogenous variables remains challenging. Prevailing discrete-time architectures often impose rigid temporal alignment across heterogeneous variables, which may limit their ability to capture continuously evolving external effects. To address this limitation, we introduce CTIA-ODE, a continuous-time forecasting framework centered on Continuous-Time Inter-Variable Attention (CTIA). Specifically, CTIA is embedded within an ordinary differential equation (ODE) solver, enabling the continuously evolving endogenous trajectory to dynamically query a static exogenous context along the integration path without requiring explicit temporal alignment. translated_title: CTIA-ODE：用于长期时间序列预测的连续时间变量间注意力机制
translated_abstract: 尽管多变量时间序列预测具有广泛的应用前景，但如何有效纳入外生变量仍然是一个挑战。主流的离散时间架构往往要求异构变量之间进行刚性的时间对齐，这可能限制其捕捉持续演变的外部影响的能力。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了CTIA-ODE，一个以连续时间变量间注意力（CTIA）为核心的连续时间预测框架。具体而言，CTIA被嵌入到常微分方程（ODE）求解器中，使持续演化的内生轨迹能够在积分路径上动态查询静态的外生上下文，而无需显式的时间对齐。为了提高连续潜在动力学的稳定性，我们进一步引入了一种双重稳定策略：在架构上，线性残差增强（LRA）模块提供宏观层面的……
tldr: 该论文提出CTIA-ODE连续时间预测框架，将连续时间变量间注意力机制嵌入常微分方程求解器中，使内生变量轨迹能够在无需时间对齐的情况下沿积分路径动态查询静态外生变量信息，并通过双重稳定策略提升连续潜在动力学的稳定性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CTIA-ODE, a continuous-time forecasting framework that embeds Continuous-Time Inter-Variable Attention within an ODE solver, enabling the evolving endogenous trajectory to dynamically query static exogenous context along the integration path without explicit temporal alignment, with a dual-stabilization strategy to improve the stability of continuous latent dynamics.
